findings.finding: The two candidates give AF-WCC-VAC-GEN different conclusion predicates. Candidate A asserts, as 'equivalent' to WCC, that the black-hole region B = M \ J-(I+) has non-empty interior whenever the development is future-incomplete. Candidate B (F0-R) explicitly lists black-hole formation as a non-goal and states the predicate without it. This is exactly the class-boundary ambiguity F1 must bind to.
findings.fix: Choose one predicate; if the black-hole-region clause is kept, attach a proof or source and reconcile it with F0-R's non-goal list.

findings.finding: Conclusion-type vocabularies differ across candidates: F0 uses {weak_cosmic_censorship, strong_cosmic_censorship_C2, strong_cosmic_censorship_C0}; F0-R uses {weak_cosmic_censorship, scc_c2_future_inextendibility, scc_c0_future_inextendibility}; A0's rubric uses formulation/conclusion_primary; F1 uses conclusion.type=open_problem. Machine class-binding checks cannot span these vocabularies.
findings.fix: Freeze one conclusion-type vocabulary in F0 and have F1/F2/A0 reference it; record truth status separately from conclusion type.

findings.finding: The only machine acceptance for F0 is self-validation: artifacts/worker-01/taxonomy_validation.json reports 82 checks passed on research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml, and F0 is authored_by deepseek-flash-01 (worker-01). Per A0 review_protocol.independence, a reviewer must not be an author. This review supplies an independent second verdict.
findings.fix: Label author-run checks as self-checks; require a non-author reviewer verdict for G-F0.

findings.finding: AF-SCC-C2 exclusions call a C0-inextendibility claim a 'higher regularity token than this class'. C0 is LOWER regularity and a STRONGER conclusion; the same file states this correctly under field_vocabulary.regularity_token.meaning_C0. The mislabel can mis-file a C0 result.

findings.fix: Normalize tokens (strip ^ and braces) before matching and add a normalization test to the guard suite.

findings.finding: Internal predicate mismatch inside revision 2: conclusion.statement quantifies over future-directed causal CURVES, while i_plus.visibility.curve_class proposes geodesic completeness 'aligned with the F0 conclusion'. Both cannot be the frozen predicate, and 'equivalently' in the statement asserts an equivalence the file itself calls unverified.
findings.fix: Pick one curve class in both places and remove 'equivalently', or file the equivalence as a lemma with a proof obligation.

findings.finding: Tool-driven formulation drift: conclusion.f0_equivalent_form records that the F0-canonical wording was kept OUT of conclusion.statement because a candidate linter flags the regularity word as a strong-censorship token (DIV-2 / G-FORM-TOKEN). Reviewer-17's own gate made the same class of error on this file (22 shape + 4 leak false positives, zero true positives), so this is a fleet-wide calibration failure, not a one-off.
findings.fix: Fix the linter's token-role rule (extension-conclusion vs development-regularity vs class declaration vs citation), then restore the F0 wording or record the equivalence as a class-level lemma. Do not let a checker's false positive choose the statement.

findings.finding: i_plus.visibility.definition asserts 'iff ... equivalently' between p in J^-(I+) and a causal curve whose past accumulates on p; formal_negation uses only J^- membership. curve_class and set_vs_point are flagged unresolved, but this definition-level equivalence is still asserted rather than flagged.
findings.fix: Split definition from the equivalence claim, or add the definition-level equivalence to unresolved.

findings.finding: Lead acceptance asks topology to declare I+/I-/i0. I- is absent and i0 appears only as the phrase 'spatial infinity'; WCC only needs I+, but the acceptance line is unmet as written.
findings.fix: Declare I- and i0, or record the acceptance-line deviation explicitly.

findings.fix: Freeze one conclusion vocabulary; keep truth status (open/proved/refuted) in a separate field.
